UNBOUND_EXAMPLE_KEY: Example string. Edit me and reload to see i18n hot-reload in dev.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_SIGN_IN_DESC: Keep your addons and settings the same on every device. Only install links and settings are stored, never addon files.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_DELETE_CONFIRM: This deletes your synced addons and settings from the Unbound servers and turns Cloud Sync off on this device. Nothing installed on your devices is removed.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_TWO_WAY_DESC: Changes on any device reach every other one.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_DOWNLOAD_DESC: This device mirrors the cloud. Changes made here are replaced.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_UPLOAD_DESC: The cloud mirrors this device. Changes from other devices are replaced.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE: Your cloud already has a setup
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_DESC: Choose how to combine it with this device. Nothing syncs until you pick.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_MERGE_DESC: Keep addons from both. The cloud's settings win where they differ.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_PULL_DESC: Replace this device's addons and settings.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_PUSH_DESC: Replace what is stored in the cloud.
UNBOUND_RECOVERY_MODE_DESC: Prevents all addons from loading while enabled.
UNBOUND_RESTART_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to restart the app?
UNBOUND_INSTALL_URL_HINT: Enter the URL of the addon manifest you want to install.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_AVAILABLE_DESC: Tap an update to read what changed.
UNBOUND_MARKETPLACE_ERROR: Couldn't reach the marketplace. Pull down to try again.
UNBOUND_MARKETPLACE_REFRESH_FAILED: Couldn't refresh. Showing the last saved copy.
UNBOUND_FONTS_HINT: Font changes apply after you relaunch.
UNBOUND_THEME_RESTART_CONFIRM: Restart now so the theme applies everywhere?
UNBOUND_PICK_COLOR_HINT: Enter a hex color, such as #5865f2.
UNBOUND_THEME_EDITOR_HINT: Colors you don't change follow Discord's light or dark appearance.
UNBOUND_THEME_DISCARD_CONFIRM: Leave the editor and lose your unsaved changes?
UNBOUND_THEME_ADVANCED_HINT: Every color Discord uses, by area.
UNBOUND_FFI_CONSENT_BODY: {name} wants to call native functions directly. A plugin with this access can read and change anything in Discord, and a mistake in it can crash the app. Only allow it if you trust where it came from.
UNBOUND_CRASH_REPORTS_DESCRIPTION: When a plugin crashes, freezes or fails to start, send its id and version, the Unbound and Discord versions, your device model and the last lines of Unbound's log to the Unbound team. Tokens, passwords and email addresses are removed from the log first, but anything a plugin logged can be in it. Your account is never included.
